charged_theorem.scope_note: the promoted paper theorem is fixed and is not broadened here; this packet is certificate engineering plus mathematical gate repair, and it re-proves nothing that the reviewed theorem report already establishes

K0_UNCONDITIONAL_THEOREM.statement: K0 is a number field of degree exactly 432, Galois and non-abelian over Q; B = Q(zeta42,r3,h) = Q(zeta_168) of degree 48; [3+r3] and [3-r3] are independent in B*/(B*)^3, spanning (Z/3)^2; K0 has exactly one factor and only the idempotents 0 and 1; K0 is finite etale of rank 432 over Z[1/42]; the ramified rational primes are exactly {2,3,7} and 5 is unramified; both registered frames are degree-1 primes, both primes split completely with exactly 432 frames, and the registered p^2 frame is the unique Hensel lift.
K0_UNCONDITIONAL_THEOREM.census: layer-restricted: only L0-L4 non-corroboration gates feed this boolean
independent_of: any degree-432 or degree-144 irreducibility claim

E_CONDITIONAL_RATIO_THEOREM.statement: given the literal displayed E = (9+5*r3)*A1*W1^4 + (9-5*r3)*A2*W2^4 read out of the sealed E5/E6 bridge, the ratio W1/W2 is K0-rational: q0 = u*(1+i)*(r3-1)/2 with u = A2/A1 and i = r3*(1+2*zeta42^14)/3 satisfies E by direct substitution, and the four branches q0*i^k are four distinct elements of K0, so t^4-c splits completely over K0 and no field extension is needed.
E_CONDITIONAL_RATIO_THEOREM.engine_note: single-engine stdlib Python. k0_field_cert_r3.gp carries no cube-root layer and cannot substitute q0 into E; its L5 block reads the literal E data and certifies the base-level reduction chain only. That is corroboration and the terminal says so; the R1 terminal's E_CONDITIONAL flag was an overstatement (review defect D7).
E_CONDITIONAL_RATIO_THEOREM.census: layer-restricted: only L5 non-corroboration gates feed this boolean
E_CONDITIONAL_RATIO_THEOREM.if_E_is_corrected: this layer must be recomputed; the unconditional layer is untouched

mutation_policy.must_fail_rule: each entry names the gate that has to report the failure; an unnamed failure elsewhere does not count

aws_route.instance_type_pin_status: EXACT. R1 shipped a six-member allowlist because the type behind the label r6b was unknown; the R1 rehearsal ran on r6i.large, so R2 pins that single type. Any other type is a source change and a new R-number.
aws_route.gp_binary_pin: coordinator-supplied path and SHA-256, verified by runner_r3 against the on-disk binary; execution_pins_r3.json additionally records the binary hash observed on the R1 rehearsal host for reporting only
aws_route.artifact_mode: 0444 after fsync; created with O_CREAT|O_EXCL on the final name, never overwritten and never staged through a temporary sidecar
aws_route.launch_lease: two independent one-shot gates on opposite sides of the privilege boundary, both before any try block: root mints at most one claim per authorization digest (spent/<digest>.spent, O_EXCL, created first, by mint_claim_r3.sh), and the unprivileged supervisor takes at most one consumption lease inside the service-owned run directory (.jc2-k0-r3-authorization-<digest>.lease, O_CREAT|O_EXCL, taken last, after every precondition). A used authorization can never be presented again; a failed precondition never consumes one.
aws_route.local_execution_mode: none; absent a live IMDSv2 identity the supervisor exits without running any mathematics
aws_route.isolated_interpreter: python3 -I -B is retained and is now a checked property: runner_r3 refuses to run outside isolated mode and loads its sealed siblings by manifest-verified path, never through sys.path

privilege_boundary.sealed_parent: root:root, mode without group or world write, symlink-free, no writable ancestor; verified unprivileged by require_root_owned_immutable and again by mint_claim_r3.sh as root with a realpath test. The service never writes here.
privilege_boundary.run_directory: root-minted, chowned to jc2k0, mode exactly 0700; the only path in ReadWritePaths. The supervisor creates no directory.
privilege_boundary.claim_token: <run dir>/.jc2-k0-r3-claim-<digest>.json, root:root 0444, minted by root inside the service-owned directory. The service cannot create it (no chown to root) and cannot modify it (no write bit for anyone but root; empty CapabilityBoundingSet excludes CAP_DAC_OVERRIDE and CAP_CHOWN). Deleting it denies only itself: CLAIM_ABSENT, nothing consumed.
privilege_boundary.mint: ExecStartPre=+ mint_claim_r3.sh, root, one-shot via spent/<digest>.spent created with O_EXCL before anything else exists.
privilege_boundary.retire: ExecStopPost=+ retire_claim_r3.sh, root, seals the finished run directory to root-owned read-only.
privilege_boundary.on_host_dry_run: custody_selftest_r3.py --on-host-dry-run, run as jc2k0 before the unit starts; calls the same verify_custody_preconditions and stops before the lease, so it consumes nothing.
privilege_boundary.fault_discipline: every custody filesystem call converts OSError into a CustodyFault; main converts anything else into CUSTODY_FAULT UNCLASSIFIED with rc 70. No custody path can produce a traceback.

producer_execution.pari_gp_not_run_reason: no gp on the producer host; the GP layer is hand-reviewed and statically census-audited by preflight_r3.py, and is executed only on the registered AWS host. No claim is made that the GP syntax or API has run.
